strategy: existing TeachingMeanStrategy(window=4); close above trailing mean => long, otherwise flat; no optimization
instrument_rules: fixed research quantization assumptions, not reconstructed historical exchange filters
execution: decision after confirmed close, execution at immediately following hourly open, full fills plus adverse tick-rounded slippage
portfolio: single-asset long/flat, 10% of current equity allocated per new entry, no continuous rebalance; idle cash earns zero; no borrowing, funding or interest
benchmark: buy and hold 10% of initial equity at first segment open, same fee/slippage and quantization, no rebalance; remaining 90% cash; cash-only return zero
segment_boundary: each segment starts flat with 10000 USDT; prior 4 bars for feature warmup only; no trading during warmup; prior final confirmed signal may execute at first segment open
terminal: primary return uses marked final equity; report hypothetical exit-cost-adjusted equity separately; no final-bar signal execution without next bar
missing_data: source-absent archive or missing bar => INVALID_DECLARED_GAP and null results for affected segment; no fill-forward, shortened segment or substituted source; checksum or malformed data => abort
statistics: full-year returns and drawdowns, fees/slippage paid, turnover, fills, risk rejection reasons, OOS calendar-quarter returns from continuous equity; no significance, alpha or prospective claims
selection: one ETH pair and existing 4-bar rule chosen for teaching; no parameter sweep; periods chosen by calendar before fetching, not by returns
